Class Roster Hub

Build a class roster once here, and load it straight into any other tool that needs one — no re-typing a class list from scratch in each one.

Scan to import this roster

Scanning imports a new copy of this roster on the other device — it won’t stay in sync after that.

Import names

Pick which column holds the name. A gradebook export usually has an ID column first, then Last and First in separate columns.

Are you sure?

Roster

Period and course are used here to group your rosters and to head the printed pages. Other tools still see the roster by its name.

Move or merge students

Tick students in the list above to move them to another roster — mid-year section changes, or splitting one big list into two. Merging pulls another roster’s names into this one without touching the original.

Archive a withdrawn student

Archiving moves a student out of the active roster — and out of Name Picker, random grouping, and every other tool that loads this roster — without erasing their name from anywhere they already have history (points, hall passes, reading logs). Restore them any time.
